rules1: I prefer communication in a polite and friendly manner. Rudeness, a condescending tone, or anything of that sort can put me off continuing the conversation, let alone taking on the project.
rules2: I’m a human too and need rest, so I’d greatly appreciate it if you don’t contact me without a real urgency between 10 PM and 9 AM Moscow time.
rules3: I don’t usually place copyright notices in visible places, and sometimes I don’t use them at all. However, if a copyright notice is present, I’d be grateful if it stays untouched.
rules4: You’re free to do whatever you like with the results of my layout work for your design, except for reselling it or transferring it to third parties, unless we’ve agreed otherwise.
rules5: You’re free to do whatever you like with the design I create for you, except for reselling it, transferring it to third parties, or creating derivative designs, unless we’ve agreed otherwise.
rules6: Full or partial copying of interactive map code for creating derivative work, especially for commercial purposes, is prohibited unless we’ve discussed other terms.
rules7: It’s hard for me to say whether my rates are high or low, but I value my work within the stated range.
rules8: My primary payment method is a transfer to a Sberbank card (for residents of Russia and cardholders of Russian banks). For cardholders of non‑Russian banks — tips via Hipolink or donations on Boosty. Any transaction fees are to be covered by you.
rules9: If needed, I can take on an urgent order and try to complete the layout within 1–2 days. Of course, urgency comes with an extra charge. This applies to layout only — I can’t create a full design from scratch in a rush in any case.
rules10: You can slice your own PSD layout if you prefer, but it’s still better to have the PSD file at hand in case any element needs to be re‑sliced. I have my own workflow, and some graphics sliced in a certain way may not suit my approach.
rules11: When ordering design, layout, or any other service from me, please specify the deadline for the work. If it’s “not urgent at all”, I may start working on it in a week or even in a month, depending on my current workload.
rules12: If for some reason you decide to cancel your order — it’s negotiable. If you haven’t made a prepayment and I haven’t started working yet, I don’t see a problem. So it’s better to cancel at an early stage. Just think twice before placing an order — do you really want it? If you’re unsure, at least don’t make a prepayment.
rules13: Regular clients may get discounts :з I also offer discounts for new clients, but the amount and conditions are discussed individually.

u27: ⚡ HTML to BB Converter for VS Code
u28: Been struggling with rewriting HTML into BB-code? Me too. I personally prefer HTML, but in forum posts, some users have it blocked by antivirus, firewall, or adblock settings, so many people stick with BB formatting. And when you need to convert HTML to BB — or write something in BB from scratch — that's where the real pain begins. As far as I know, there are no decent BB-code editors, let alone HTML‑to‑BB converters specifically tailored for the MyBB / Rusff platform.
u29: That's why, together with Deepseek, we wrote a VS Code extension that understands BB markup syntax and can convert HTML into the most appropriate BB tags.
